response.overview: Through three different stories and human experiences, Before places its characters in moral dilemmas that expose the contradiction between the principles they believe in and the actions they may be driven to take under pressure. Guided by the principle of “See No Evil, Hear No Evil, Speak No Evil,” each character finds themselves facing a choice between standing by their convictions or abandoning them. The film raises a question about the strength of our principles, and what it takes for us to compromise them
response.tagline: Before we see, before we hear, or before we speak? Or before we are forced to make a choice?
response.title: قبل أن
